We designed this app to simplify our own trips, and now we’re sharing it with you to help make your adventures just as easy and enjoyable as ours.

baby-feeding-tracker.description:
You’re rocking a half-sleeping newborn, glancing at the clock, trying to remember the last feed:
Was it two hours ago? Left breast or right? How many ounces did she finish?

New-mom brain fog is real. Between growth spurts, night wakings, pediatric visits, and “Is the baby gaining enough?” worries, the simple act of logging feeds can feel impossible. Scribbling on scraps of paper, toggling between timer apps, or guessing when the doctor asks only adds stress. You deserve better.

Baby Feeding Tracker is laser-focused on one thing: capturing every feed in one thumb press, so you can stop memorizing and start resting.

* One-Tap Start, One-Tap Stop *
Open the app, tap once, and the timer (or ounce entry) is running. That’s it. No clunky menus or hidden settings to fumble through while cradling your baby.

* Always Know Which Side *
The app remembers where you started last session and clearly tells you which breast to begin with next. No more hair-tie tricks or guessing games.

* Precise Bottle Volume *
Bottle-feeding? Record ounces or milliliters in seconds - perfect for mixed-feeding parents who need exact intake numbers.

* Instant “Last Feed” View *
The moment you stop the timer, the Home screen shows how long ago your baby ate and which side is up next. One glance and you’re calm again.

• Gentle Reminders
Set customizable alerts so you never stretch that feed interval longer than planned—especially useful during growth spurts or overnight.

• Doctor-Ready Reports
Generate beautiful PDF or CSV logs covering any date range. Hand them to your pediatrician or lactation consultant and skip the awkward “Um… I think it was around 3 a.m.” moments.

* Peace-of-Mind Insights *
Daily and 30-day summaries reveal patterns: average session length, total minutes on each side, and bottle intake trends. If something drifts off-track, you’ll see it first.

* Built for the night shift *
Dark-mode first, giant buttons, haptic confirmations, and thumb-reachable controls mean you can operate everything while half-awake, with one hand, without struggling with a bright screen in the nursery.

Free forever for essential logging
Download and log every feed - breast or bottle - without paying a cent. The core memory relief is yours to keep.

Upgrade to Baby Feeding Tracker Pro for full confidence
Unlock powerful features that turn raw logs into actionable peace of mind:

Unlimited Smart Reminders

PDF Export - instant, shareable doctor reports so your doctor can best advise you 

30-Day Insights – spot patterns before they become problems

Priority Support – get answers fast!

Please note
While the app is free to download, full functionality - including access to unlimited reminders, exports, and extended insights - requires an in-app subscription.

Whether you're dominating the court, picking up some new techniques or crushing PRs in the gym, Clip It makes sure your best moments are saved—automatically, hands-free, and instantly shareable.

* Pickleball, Tennis, Volleyball – Never miss an epic rally, spike, or match-winning shot.
* Weightlifters – Watch your form, track progress, and relive every rep without scrubbing through hours of footage.

How It Works:
1. Record effortlessly – No need to scroll through endless footage. Clip It captures your key moments automatically.
2. Instant Highlights – Get only the good stuff, no dull moments.
3. Auto-Create Reels – Your clips instantly turn into a highlight reel.
4. Share in Two Clicks – Show off your plays or lifts with coaches, friends, or social media.

Go Hands-Free with Apple Watch
* Start, stop, and capture highlights without touching your phone. Focus on your game or lift, and let Clip It do the rest.

No extra editing. No hassle. Just your best moments, ready to watch and share.

Download Clip It now and level up your game.

charadas.description:
Charadas es el juego de fiesta más divertido para familias y amigos. Simple, rápido y lleno de momentos ridículos, ¡solo necesitas tu teléfono y ganas de pasarlo bien! Con cientos de palabras en español para actuar, reír y adivinar, este juego convierte cualquier reunión en una experiencia inolvidable.

¿Cómo se juega?
Muy fácil: gira tu teléfono a modo horizontal, toca para empezar y ACTÚA la palabra sin decirla. Los demás deben adivinarla antes de que el tiempo se acabe. Usa gestos, caras graciosas, movimientos exagerados… ¡todo vale menos hablar! Cada ronda es corta, intensa y perfecta para romper el hielo o animar cualquier fiesta.

Ideal para cualquier ocasión
• No requiere preparación
• Perfecto para fiestas, reuniones familiares o viajes
• Palabras para todas las edades
• Diversión inmediata: empieza con un solo toque

Características principales
• Totalmente en español: categorías pensadas para hispanohablantes
• Modo horizontal para jugar cómodamente
• Categorías editables: agrega o cambia palabras desde un archivo
• Rondas rápidas llenas de energía
• Perfecto para grupos de 2 a 20 personas
• Diseño simple, claro y divertido

Diversión para todos
Ajusta la dificultad según tu grupo. Palabras fáciles para jugar en familia, palabras más locas para amigos o fiestas. Puedes crear tus propias listas para hacer el juego aún más personal y divertido.

Un juego que une a las personas
Charadas recupera la magia de jugar cara a cara, reír juntos y crear recuerdos. No importa la edad ni la ocasión: siempre es buen momento para jugar.

Listo para empezar?
Gira tu teléfono, toca y… ¡ACTÚA!


ENGLISH

Charadas is the ultimate party game for families and friends. Simple, fast, and full of hilarious moments, all you need is your phone and the desire to have fun! With hundreds of Spanish words to act out, guess, and laugh about, this game turns any gathering into an unforgettable experience.

How does it work?
Super easy: turn your phone to landscape mode, tap to start, and ACT out the word without saying it. Everyone else must guess before time runs out. Use gestures, silly faces, exaggerated movements—anything goes except talking! Each round is quick, energetic, and perfect for breaking the ice or bringing life to a party.

Perfect for any occasion
• No setup required
• Great for parties, family nights, or trips
• Words for all ages
• Instant fun: start in one tap

Key features
• Fully in Spanish with categories crafted for Spanish speakers
• Landscape mode for easy group play
• Editable categories so you can add or change words from a file
• Quick rounds that keep the energy high
• Perfect for groups of 2–20
• Simple, fun, and clean design

Fun for everyone
Adjust the difficulty based on your group. Use easy words for family time, or wild, silly ones for friends. Create your own custom lists to make the game even more fun and personal.

A game that brings people together
Charadas brings back the joy of laughing face-to-face and making memories. No matter the age or the event, there’s always a perfect moment to play.

Ready to play?
Turn your phone, tap, and… ACT!

server-tip-tracker.description:
Ever finish a long week of work and think: “I know I worked a lot… but which days actually made me the most money?”

Maybe some shifts felt exhausting but didn’t pay off. Others flew by and somehow brought in way more than expected. If you’re juggling different days, roles, or companies, it’s surprisingly hard to tell what’s really worth your time.

That’s the gap this app fills!

Knowing what you earn isn’t enough - what really matters is knowing when, where, and why you earn the most.

This app is built for tipped and hourly workers who want clarity, confidence, and control over their income. Whether you’re a server, bartender, freelancer, or working multiple roles, we help you turn scattered pay into clear insights.

WHY TRACK EARNINGS?
Research consistently shows that people track income to:
- Gain financial awareness and reduce money stress
- Identify high-value shifts, days, or employers
- Improve scheduling decisions and avoid burnout
- Maintain clean records for taxes and budgeting

But spreadsheets are tedious, and most apps don’t reflect how real work happens.

What this app does for you
- Log tips and hours in seconds. No friction, no clutter
- Visualize earnings trends over any date range
- See your top earning days of the week
- Compare income by company or role
- Understand your true average per day
- Spot patterns that help you earn more with less effort

Everything is designed to be fast, intuitive, and actually useful so you spend less time tracking and more time making informed decisions about your work.
